test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A shopping mart offers four different discounts schemes on the sale of an object as follows:

(1) A discount of 30%

(2) Two successive discounts of 15%

(3) Buy 2, get 1 free

(4) Buy 5, get 3 free

Which discount scheme offers the maximum discount to a customer?
solution: Formula used: Effective discount = x + y - (x × y)/100 effective discount = (Article get free)/(Total articles) × 100 Calculation: Scheme I. A discount of 30% = 30% Scheme II. Two successive discounts of 15%
